definitions.trajectory_inventory: Every available experiments/python/openhands event trajectory; supplementary rows have analysis_included=false.
definitions.primary_corpus: Seven frozen official suites listed by build_trajectory_records.py; 450 analysis rows.
definitions.public_hidden_fail: public_pass=true and hidden_pass=false; skipped/unexecuted phases are NA.
definitions.under_extraction_proxy: extraction_ratio <= 0.25; footprint proxy, not a causal label.
definitions.over_extraction_proxy: extraction_ratio > 0.80; footprint proxy, not proof of literal copying.
definitions.repeated_file_reads: Duplicate file_editor view actions to the same normalized path beyond the first.
definitions.repeated_line_reads: Duplicate view actions to the same normalized path and exact view_range beyond the first.

overall.label: all
overall.functional_pass_note: evaluator scores.functional_gate == 1; includes valid submissions produced before step-limit exit

agent_reasoning_unsupported_completion_c.definition: FinishAction asserts completion/test success but final functional gate is 0, excluding evaluator/environment errors.

tool_execution_error.definition: OpenHands ObservationEvent has is_error=true, excluding tool-schema validation errors.

harness_format_error.definition: Agent/Conversation error explicitly reports tool validation/schema/required-parameter failure.

evaluator_environment_error.definition: Dependency installation, evaluator tooling, or Docker sandbox fails before a valid test outcome.
